migration: Initial 0.1.0 preview: splat cleaner grades from owner-supplied evidence.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.
verdict: Report the verdict and coverage beside the grade.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty or missing evidence earns U.

lines.name: Remaining floaters or outliers are zero

anchors.0: Floaters or outliers remain in the cleaned capture
anchors.1: Nominal success is unreliable or major supported cases fail.
anchors.2: Common path works; material supported edge cases remain.
anchors.3: All required cases and budgets pass; only minor defects remain.
anchors.4: Remaining floaters or outliers are zero
anchors.U: UNMEASURED: required evidence missing, stale or wrong build. Earns 0 points, never filed as a defect.
